title: Health Checks and Load Balancing
description: Implement health checks and load balancing algorithms.

data.text: Health checks ensure traffic only goes to healthy instances. Load balancing distributes requests across instances. Together they provide reliability and performance.

terms.definition: A probe that determines if a service instance is healthy.
A check that determines if the process is running.
A check that determines if the service can accept traffic.
The strategy for distributing requests across instances.

rows: Pick instance with fewest active connections
Route by key to same instance

data.text: Health checks integrate with circuit breakers. When an instance fails health checks, the circuit breaker stops routing to it until it recovers.

items: Use readiness probes to control traffic
Set appropriate check intervals and timeouts
